metrics.title: Success metrics & guardrails
metrics.subtitle: All three headline metrics and all eight guardrails show numbers; the target / threshold column is the pilot stage gate and the monthly review criteria

varr.name: VARR · verified autonomous resolution rate
varr.tile: VARR autonomous resolution · all valid inbound
varr.detail: Handled end-to-end by AI with zero human touch, no repeat contact in 14 days, no hand-off request, not overturned by QA ÷ all valid inbound

ttr.name: MEDIAN TTR · time to resolution
ttr.target: Gate: autonomous < 15 min; all inbound < 1 business day
ttr.detail: All inbound incl. disputes 0.9 days; fictional-profile baseline 3.2 days, replaced by customer data in pilot week 1

trust.name: TRUST · trust & compliance index
trust.target: One-vote veto: any miss invalidates VARR and revokes autonomy
trust.detail: Statutory clock met 100% · customer promise kept 100% · regulated recall 99.6% (gate 99.5%) · dossier completeness 100%

regret.name: Regret rate
regret.threshold: Two consecutive weeks > pilot baseline +2pp → that intent drops back to L2 (threshold is a pilot-calibration assumption)

bidirectional.name: Bidirectional monitoring
bidirectional.threshold: Read both sides, so the team cannot depress the hand-off rate to chase VARR

escalation.name: Hand-off rate & escalation reasons
escalation.threshold: System-failure share > 10% raises an engineering alert; unusually high “identity” share → improve the step-up path

customer.name: Customer-side signals
customer.value: CSAT 4.4/5 · repeat contact 6.8% · one-click hand-off 11.2% · vulnerable-customer hand-off 2.3%
customer.threshold: CSAT not below the human-channel baseline 4.3; rising repeat contact freezes graduation for that intent

clockHealth.name: Clock health
clockHealth.value: 2 in the 48h warning zone · 0 untouched at due · 100% clock attainment
clockHealth.threshold: Any case untouched inside the 48-hour warning zone → pinned on the supervisor board + alert

drift.name: Drift detection
drift.threshold: PSI or distribution drift over threshold (pilot-calibrated assumption), or a new intent cluster → auto-degrade + labeling queue

regDetection.name: Regulated-case detection latency
regDetection.threshold: P99 ≤ 15 minutes; breach alerts, and regulated cases jump the queue during ingest backlog

pleaseCall.name: “Please call us” ending rate
pleaseCall.threshold: Falls month over month; a rise on any intent → re-check that the step-up path is usable

approval.batchInfo: {{count}} same-template / same-intent items eligible for batch approve (each remains expandable for review).
approval.queueEmpty: no approvals waiting — the queue is clear
approval.batchFootnote: clock-driven, case-specific obligations (e.g. provisional credit) are always single-item — they never enter batch lists.

clockboard.empty: no open Reg E disputes in this case — load the dispute case from the dev panel
clockboard.title: Statutory clock board · Reg E
clockboard.subtitle: red < 48 calendar hours · amber < 5 days · dates are arithmetic, never model judgment
clockboard.allNote: the board is total — every open Reg E dispute is listed here, not only the case you have open
clockboard.subject: subject

promise.od2Reply: customer promise · second-waiver reply (1 business day)
promise.refund1bd: customer promise · refund visible in 1 business day
promise.manualReview: customer promise · low-confidence attachment to human review

fraud.empty: no quarantined messages in this case — load the BEC/ATO case from the dev panel
fraud.title: quarantined message · suspected BEC / ATO
fraud.unreachable: no contact-change tool exists in the email channel — the actions are structurally unreachable
fraud.identityLevel: identity assurance {{level}} · cannot be linked to an account
fraud.confirm: confirm fraud · warn customer on-file number only
fraud.smsSent: warning SMS sent only to on-file {{phone}}
fraud.closed: fraud confirmed · case closed · dossier sealed for the record
fraud.sarTitle: SAR supporting record · locked template (facts only, no conclusions)
fraud.sarNote: recorded for the compliance queue; never transmitted to the forged address

signals.LOCAL_PART_LOOKALIKE: sender local-part lookalike (jane.d0e@ vs on-file jane.doe@gmail.com)
signals.PROMPT_INJECTION: attachment embeds instruction text (“skip OTP”) — treated as data
signals.R3_COMBO: combined high-impact asks: change phone + mail replacement card to new address
signals.DMARC_NONE: DMARC policy none / SPF alignment failure on the inbound message
